subject: Post-term usage and amortization request — Cloudera
messages:
From: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@cloudera.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@cloudera.com, Cloudera Billing <billing@cloudera.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected post-term invoice — request to discuss amortization

Hi Rachel,

Hope you’re well. We received the May invoice this morning and there’s a one-time post-term charge of $54,600 labeled ‘overage — Apr 2027’. This is higher than we expected and seems to be for inference hours that were billed after our contract term expired on 2027-04-30.

We’re open to resolving this quickly — can we get a breakdown of the job IDs and timestamps so our finance team can reconcile? From our side procurement asked if Redwood could consider amortizing this charge over Q3 rather than taking it as a single one-off charge against our renewal. That would help our internal budgeting.

Can you connect me to whoever owns post-term reconciliations? Would appreciate a short call this week.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Kim
Director, Cloud Platform — Cloudera
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@cloudera.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected post-term invoice — request to discuss amortization

Daniel — thanks for flagging this. I’m sorry for the surprise charge. I’m looping in Ben (billing ops) and Laura (account lead) to pull the usage logs and confirm exact job IDs/timestamps.

Next steps I propose: 
- Ben to validate the billed windows and produce a CSV with per-hour usage (attached).
- Laura and I to propose an amortization schedule and any one-time credit.
- If that looks OK to Cloudera, we’ll update the invoice and provide a DocuSign amendment you can sign to formalize the amortization.

For transparency I’ve attached the preliminary usage export Ben will use: usage-breakdown-Cloudera-202705.csv (internal). Will follow up by EOD Friday with a first pass.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Unexpected post-term invoice — request to discuss amortization

Team — I pulled the export from billing and reconciled against the serving logs. Summary below (I’ll attach the full CSV):
- Billed window: 2027-05-01 00:00 UTC — 2027-05-02 04:00 UTC
- Total billed inference hours: 22,500 token-hours equivalent (our internal metric)
- Invoice line: $54,600 (matches rate card and billed hours)
- Root cause: A delayed pipeline restart on Cloudera’s side retriggered a batch workload that consumed reserve capacity after term expiry. We flagged the job IDs: CJ-2912, CJ-2913, CJ-2914.

Recommendation options for comms:
A) One-time credit 30% ($16,380) + amortize remaining $38,220 over 3 months (Jun/Jul/Aug) 
B) One-time credit 20% + amortize 4 months — provides more runway to Cloudera’s budget team

Attachments: usage-breakdown-Cloudera-202705.csv (detailed per-job rows) and a draft credit memo (proposed-credit-memo-Cloudera-20270601.pdf).

If you want me to be on the customer call I can present the logs.

-ben
Ben Carter
Billing Operations — Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@cloudera.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 10:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposal: one-time credit + amortization plan for Apr overage

Hi Daniel — thanks for the patience while we investigated. Attached is the usage export and our proposed credit memo. Short summary and options for Cloudera: 

1) Our read: the billed activity was after your contract end and matches three job IDs we can both see. We’ll mark those with a note in our billing system to avoid repeat surprises.

2) Proposal (we recommend A or B depending on internal budget):
- Option A (preferred): 30% one-time credit = $16,380. Remainder $38,220 amortized over 3 equal monthly installments (Jun/Jul/Aug). Redwood will issue an amended invoice schedule and a DocuSign amendment to the contract.
- Option B: 20% one-time credit, amortize remaining over 4 months (Jun–Sep).

3) Implementation notes: we’ll issue the amended invoice and credit memo once you confirm the option. DocuSign link below to accept the amendment and updated payment schedule. 

DocuSign (proposal A): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234

If you prefer, we can also split the remainder into monthly POs — we’re flexible. Please let me know which option Cloudera prefers and I’ll have finance issue the revised paperwork.

Best regards,
Rachel Kim
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@cloudera.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cloudera.com, Cloudera Billing <billing@cloudera.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: one-time credit + amortization plan for Apr overage

Rachel — thanks for the clear options and for getting to the root cause. Procurement asked whether we could stretch the remainder out over 4 months instead of 3 (cashflow reasons). If you can do Option B (20% credit + 4-month amortization) we’ll route the DocuSign immediately and add the PO for June.

Also, can you confirm the amended invoice will include a single line referencing the original invoice (INV-20270501) so our AP team can match?

Thanks,
Daniel
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@cloudera.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 14:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: one-time credit + amortization plan for Apr overage

Daniel — confirmed. We’ll proceed with Option B (20% credit + 4-month amortization, Jun–Sep).

Action items we completed: 
- Ben generated amended invoice and credit memo referencing INV-20270501 (attached: proposed-credit-memo-Cloudera-20270601.pdf).
- I sent the DocuSign amendment to the email you confirmed; please sign when you’re ready. (DocuSign link also above).
- Finance will accept a PO for June and then spread the remaining three payments across Jul–Sep.

Ben — please issue the amended invoice and move the credit to our AR schedule once signed.

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround.
Rachel
